# leaflet-rotate 0.2.8

Source: https://github.com/Raruto/leaflet-rotate

Distribution: https://unpkg.com/leaflet-rotate@0.2.8/dist/leaflet-rotate.js

License: GPL-3.0, see LICENSE. Distribution is stored locally for offline use.

The campus viewer uses a fixed bearing; rotation controls and gesture rotation are disabled. Geographic coordinates remain unchanged.
